item.title: Sub-millisecond Timer Precision in Go 1.28
item.description:
Quiz: time.Sleep(50 * time.Microsecond) on Linux. How long does it actually sleep?

If you said 50µs, you’re wrong. Let’s see why and how to fix it.

item.title: Why Time Differences Can't Be Trusted
item.description: Time granularity on Windows is much lower than you’d expect, and that can cause surprising bugs when measuring elapsed time.

item.title: Writing a Golang client for the Tensorflow Serving Inception model
item.description: Tensorflow Serving is the most optimized way to serve a Tensorflow machine learning model in production. The official tutorials only cover the python client, so lets implement a Go/Golang one.
